component.name: Fathom
component.summary: A modern Jellyfin desktop client with optional Seerr requests and a built-in YouTube player

description.p: Fathom is a desktop Jellyfin client built with Flutter and media_kit (libmpv), so playback is mpv-grade: direct play with transcode fallback, proper subtitle and audio track handling, and hardware decoding.

ul.li: Movies, TV, music, and Live TV, with mpv-grade playback and hardware decoding
One shared player across everything, with picture-in-picture and a pop-out desktop window
Optional Seerr: discover, request, and manage requests without leaving the page
Optional ad-free YouTube client with subscriptions, playlists, and downloads
Ratings, watch together (SyncPlay), and full server administration

description.p: Beta: full interface internationalization, refined player chrome, and desktop pop-out.
